{{Short description|Israeli philosopher}}
{{BLP sources|date=March 2021}}
'''Carl Jeffrey Posy''' ({{langx|he|קרל פוזי|italic=no}}) is an Israeli philosopher. He is a full professor [[emeritus]] in the Department of [[Philosophy]] at the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in [[Jerusalem]], Israel.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Carl Posy |url=https://en.philosophy.huji.ac.il/people/carl-posy |access-date=7 December 2022}}</ref><ref name="huji">{{cite web| url=https://scholars.huji.ac.il/llcc/people/carl-posy | title=Carl Posy – PhD, Yale University, 1971 | work=People | publisher=[[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] | location=Israel | access-date=30 January 2018 }}</ref>

Carl Posy received his [[PhD degree]] from [[Yale University]] in the [[United States]] in 1971.<ref name="huji" />

==Publications==
Posy's areas of research interest include the [[philosophy of mathematics]], [[philosophical logic]], the [[history of philosophy]] (particularly [[Kant]] and his predecessors).<ref name="huji"/> His publications include:

* ''Kant’s Philosophy of Mathematics: Modern Essays'', [[Springer (publisher)|Springer]], 1992. {{ISBN|978-0-7923-1495-0}}
* ''Computability: [[Alan Turing|Turing]], [[Kurt Gödel|Gödel]], [[Alonzo Church|Church]], and Beyond'' (with [[Jack Copeland]] and [[Oron Shagrir]]), [[MIT Press]], 2013. {{ISBN|978-0262527484}}.<ref name="mit-press">{{cite web| url=https://mitpress.mit.edu/authors/carl-j-posy | title=Carl J. Posy | publisher=[[MIT Press]] | access-date=30 January 2018 }}</ref>

Posy is a former Academic Director of the [[National Library of Israel]].<ref name="jpost">{{cite web| url=https://www.jpost.com/Israel/National-Library-to-be-established-in-Jerusalem | title=National Library to be Established in Jerusalem | first=Ehud Zion | last=Waldoks | date=27 November 2007 | newspaper=[[The Jerusalem Post]] | access-date=30 January 2018 }}</ref><ref name="unc">{{cite web | url=https://sils.unc.edu/events/2012/carl-posy | title=Former Academic Director of the National Library of Israel to speak at UNC at Chapel Hill | publisher=[[University of North Carolina]] | date=2012 | access-date=30 January 2018 | archive-date=7 July 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140707165110/https://sils.unc.edu/events/2012/carl-posy | url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="lisnews">{{cite web| url=https://lisnews.org/node/28372 | title=National Library to be established in Jerusalem | work=LISNews | date=29 November 2007 | author=Blake | access-date=3 March 2020 }}</ref>
